name: @steuererklaerung/dms
author: Pascal Garber
description: Document-management abstraction for steuererklaerung: the back-end-agnostic DmsProvider (built-in DMS + Paperless-ngx), the AI receipt extraction ("KI statt OCR"), and the store↔document reconciliation read-path. Shared by the CLI/web and the future native GNOME app. Pure TypeScript, runs on Node + GJS via gjsify.
